primer: Tanfac Industries (TANFACIND) operates a 54-year-old Cuddalore fluorochemical moat and leads India in 10,000 TPA Solar-Grade DHF. A 7-year ₹2,362.5 Cr Japanese contract anchors its growth, yet trailing valuation at CMP ₹3,349.40 sits at 104x P/E. Meanwhile, operating margins compressed from 24% to 12%, and FY26 free cash flow printed -₹39 Cr. New capital is REJECTED at 0.95:1 support asymmetry, while 70 held shares (5.46% weight) shift to TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH—trimming 35 shares into any ₹3,450–₹3,648 bounce and holding 35 under a ₹2,802.12 hard stop.
